_doc.setup: Copy to accounts.local.json (git-ignored) and fill in this machine's accounts. Scripts read accounts.local.json, else this file. A leading ~/ means your home directory.
_doc.claude.t3Instance: T3 provider instance your Claude orchestrator threads use.
_doc.claude.t3WorkerInstance: T3 instance for Claude workers (a profile with a smaller auto-compact window). Same as t3Instance if you have only one.
_doc.codex.default: Codex account name used when ACCOUNT is unset.
_doc.codex.accounts[].name: Name you pass as ACCOUNT=<name>.
_doc.codex.accounts[].home: CODEX_HOME for that account (run.sh, and usage.mjs reads models_cache.json there).
_doc.codex.accounts[].t3Instance: T3 provider instance id for that account (t3-thread.mjs, usage.mjs).
_doc.codex.accounts[].reserve: ACCOUNT=auto uses reserve accounts only after every other account is low (a window at 90%+) or lacks the model.
_doc.jobRoots: Optional extra job directories (a project's own copy of the subagents skill) that thread cleanup and parent lookup also scan, besides AGENT_JOBS_DIR.
_doc.messageBoard.feedback: Optional: the command a message-board brief tells agents to use to report a board gap (the brief's last line). Empty leaves the line out.
